errors.credentials: Check your Frisquet email and password. For an existing device, sign in again using Repair in its settings.
errors.network: Cannot reach Frisquet Connect. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.timeout: Frisquet Connect did not respond in time. Check the device state before retrying.
errors.rate_limit: Frisquet Connect is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
errors.service: Frisquet Connect could not complete the request.
errors.response: Frisquet Connect returned an unexpected response.
errors.no_sites: This Frisquet account has no connected installations.
errors.no_zone: This heating zone is no longer present on the Frisquet installation.
errors.no_water: This installation does not expose controllable hot-water modes.
errors.unsupported: This control is not supported by the installation.
errors.temperature: Choose a temperature from 5 to 25 °C in steps of 0.5 °C.
errors.holiday: Holiday mode is active. End it in Frisquet Connect before changing the heating mode.
errors.state: The current heating profile is unknown. Wait for the next automatic update or choose a specific profile temperature.
errors.stopped: This device is disconnected. Reopen the device and try again.

support.title: Support report
support.intro: After reproducing the problem, use Homey’s Create Diagnostics Report to send recent app logs directly to the developer.
support.privacy: Passwords, tokens, names, contacts, addresses and equipment identifiers are anonymized. Operating data such as temperatures and modes remains in the report. Nothing is sent until you choose to share it.
support.failed: The saved history could not be loaded. Try again or use Homey’s app diagnostic report.
support.ready: History ready. Review it below before sharing.
support.share: Review this saved history before sharing it. You can attach the JSON to a support issue. It is also added to the app log for your next Homey diagnostic report.
support.select_copy: The report is selected. Use your device’s Copy command.
support.cleared: Stored local history cleared. Homey manages its own app logs separately.
support.mobile: Mobile: More → Apps → Frisquet Connect → settings gear → Create Diagnostics Report.
support.web: Web: Settings → Frisquet Connect → Create Diagnostics Report.
support.native_help: Close this configuration page to find that button. Describe what went wrong in Homey’s report form and send it. Recent anonymized responses, errors and software versions are already in the log.
support.availability: Homey shows its report button for App Store installations. If it is missing, or you need a longer history, use the advanced export below.
support.advanced_help: Use this for a development installation, to inspect saved data, or when support requests a longer history. Previewing saves nothing to an external service.

preferences.title: Frisquet Connect settings
preferences.intro: These settings apply to all Frisquet devices on this Homey.
preferences.poll_help: Choose 5–60 minutes. Commands are checked sooner; failed requests retry with increasing delays.
preferences.connection_help: Notify once when readings cannot be refreshed for the chosen delay, then once when updates resume.
preferences.alarms: New boiler and service alarm notifications
preferences.alarms_help: Notify when a new alarm appears in a Frisquet response. An unchanged alarm is not repeated. A cleared alarm can notify again if it returns.
preferences.notification_help: Notifications use Homey’s notification system. Delivery to your phone depends on your Homey notification settings.
preferences.load_failed: Could not load settings. Close this page and try again.
preferences.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the values and try again.
preferences.invalid: Choose a refresh interval of 5–60 minutes and a notification delay of 5–120 minutes, using whole numbers.

notifications.connection_lost: __installation__: readings could not be refreshed from Frisquet Connect for __minutes__ minutes.
notifications.connection_restored: __installation__: Frisquet Connect readings are updating again.
